meaning:
συν-παρα-γίνομαι
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Psa.83:8 (לָוָה ni.) * ;]
1. to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, Luk.23:48.
2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; 2Ti.4:16, Rec.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.
